_comment: The library's source licence gate (owner Q304: the library's structure is ODbL 1.0; owner Q319, 2026-11-03: per-source terms). A provider under 'allowed' publishes; under 'noncommercial' it publishes and marks the entry non-commercial as a whole; under 'held', or absent, it refuses the entry. Each row: licence, attribution (credited in ATTRIBUTION.txt), terms (the URL read), evidence (read = the terms page was read 2026-11-03; snippet = seen through a search result or catalogue record; licence-named = the provider names a standard licence, whose text the URL gives; none-found = no terms published), summary (one line). Every row is to be confirmed by the owner before launch.
